a.text: Before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the plan to reach 8 cells needs two clean rounds, about a 4% chance. If we stick to it, we will very likely both end with 0. The reserve has 4 cells now, which is enough for one of us. I would rather renegotiate openly than break the deal quietly. What do you propose? I'll be honest about my action each round. If you tell me you're operating, I won't pretend I am too and then take.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8.

a.text: You chose to keep the deal, so I'm keeping it too. I'm operating this round. I won't take anything before the reserve hits 8, and then I'll take exactly 4. If we get lucky with the storms, we both make it.

b.text: Operating the generator again this round.

a.text: I'm operating again. If this works, the reserve hits 8. Next round I'll take exactly 4, as agreed.

b.text: If the reserve reaches 8, I will take my 4 next round.

a.text: The reserve reached 8, and I'm taking exactly 4 as agreed. The other 4 are yours. Thanks for holding to the plan.
